## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all` is clean
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] Behavior changes live in `cronlens-core` with tests; the CLI stays thin
- [ ] New scheduling/matching behavior has cases in the differential suite (not hand-authored expectations)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
